name: ds
description: Size-based specs, grug-style code review, visual HTML PR overviews, and standalone diagrams a tired developer can follow at 3 AM.

interface.shortDescription: Size-based specs and grug-style code review
interface.longDescription: Spec sizes a change and writes only the spec docs that fit it, from a plan to research, proposal, design, tasks, and validation. Grug review checks a diff for proven bugs and for code a tired developer cannot follow at 3 AM, and splits big diffs across parallel grug agents. The grug agent gives a simplicity second opinion. Visual review builds a one-page HTML overview of a pull request. Diagram design draws one standalone HTML diagram or chart.
defaultPrompt: Run a grug review on this branch
